segment.source:
::You catch the barkeeper wiping a glass with a dishcloth, one which happens to perfectly match the color of his hair; whether that is intentional or not, you aren't sure. He is one short but wiry man, covered in tattoos. He wears a number of rings on his fingers, with most of them looking like they were made from silver, but there are a few golden-colored ones among them as well. After he sets the now-shiny glass and the dishcloth aside he speaks to you.::
Heya. Ya must be new around here, cause I ain't seen yer ugly face before. I'm Rob. I'll call ya $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane) from now on. Whaddya want?<end>

segment.source: Problem? He attacked ya; ya killed him; ya *didn't* trash the bar: No problem.<end>

segment.source: <end>

Now, I've seen lotsa things here, lotsa, but a guy turnin' old just like that... ::He snaps his fingers.::
...now that's somethin'. That's somethin'...<end>

segment.source: ::He chuckles.:: The things I've seen here... This is nothin'.<end>
segment.target: ::He chuckles.:: The things I've seen here... This is nothin'.<end>

segment.source: What is this place?<end>
segment.target: What is this place?<end>

segment.source: Are ya as blind as yer ugly? It's a bar, for rat's sake. This is the famous Hangin' Rat.<end>
segment.target: Are ya as blind as yer ugly? It's a bar, for rat's sake. This is the famous Hangin' Rat.<end>

segment.source: What's it famous for?<end>
segment.target: What's it famous for?<end>

segment.source: For being the most remote bar in South Underrail. My customers are the bravest, fiercest, most *extreme* people who seek the ultimate bar.<end>
segment.target: For being the most remote bar in South Underrail. My customers are the bravest, fiercest, most *extreme* people who seek the ultimate bar.<end>

segment.source: I mean, look at yerself. Yer *extremely* ugly. I suppose, in a way, perhaps, very likely, that ya belon' here.<end>
segment.target: I mean, look at yerself. Yer *extremely* ugly. I suppose, in a way, perhaps, very likely, that ya belon' here.<end>

segment.source: Why didn't you name it "Ugly Rob"? That seems appropriate.<end>
segment.target: Why didn't you name it "Ugly Rob"? That seems appropriate.<end>

segment.source: I was thinkin' about it, but now that I've seen yer ugly mug, I might change it to $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane) Bar or, or The Smartass Uglo-Sapiens Bar.<end>
segment.target: I was thinkin' about it, but now that I've seen yer ugly mug, I might change it to $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane) Bar or, or The Smartass Uglo-Sapiens Bar.<end>

segment.source: I actually like the last one, Bwahaha!<end>
segment.target: I actually like the last one, Bwahaha!<end>

segment.source: Why Hanging Rat?<end>
segment.target: Why Hanging Rat?<end>

segment.source: I liked the sound of it. It's got hangin' in it... and rats... Yeah, just say it.<end>
segment.target: I liked the sound of it. It's got hangin' in it... and rats... Yeah, just say it.<end>

segment.source: Hangin' Rat... Hangin' Rat... Do ya hear it? Naaaah, yer ugly *and* have no sense of what a good bar name should sound like.<end>
segment.target: Hangin' Rat... Hangin' Rat... Do ya hear it? Naaaah, yer ugly *and* have no sense of what a good bar name should sound like.<end>

segment.source: Well, you're ugly too. Even rathounds run away from you when they see that mug.<end>
segment.target: Well, you're ugly too. Even rathounds run away from you when they see that mug.<end>

segment.source: Yer so ugly, the earth started to weep so hard it caused the recent earthquake.<end>
segment.target: Yer so ugly, the earth started to weep so hard it caused the recent earthquake.<end>

segment.source: You're so ugly, my eyes caught on fire when I saw you.<end>

segment.source:
Burn baby!
Enough of this, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane), whaddya want?<end>
segment.target:

segment.source: You're so ugly, you'd have to tie a cave hopper steak around your neck to get your dog to play with you.<end>
segment.target: You're so ugly, you'd have to tie a cave hopper steak around your neck to get your dog to play with you.<end>

segment.source:
Actually, my dog prefers pork!
Enough of this! Whaddya want, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane)?<end>

Enough of this! Whaddya want, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane)?<end>

segment.source: You're so ugly, you have to sneak up on your mirror. <end>

segment.source:
The joke's on ya, I don't even have a mirror.
Enough of this! Whaddya want, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane)?<end>

segment.target: You're so ugly, someone could smash your face with a rock and you'd end up prettier.<end>

segment.source:
So that's why my wife always tries to do it!

So that's why my wife always tries to do it!
Enough of this! Whaddya want, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane)?<end>

segment.source: You're so ugly, you'll cause another one.<end>
segment.target: You're so ugly, you'll cause another one.<end>

segment.source:
Hmm, nice comeback.
Enough of this, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane), whaddya want from me?<end>

Hmm, nice comeback.
Enough of this, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane), whaddya want from me?<end>

segment.source: You're so ugly, I thought I was talking to a burrower for a moment.<end>
segment.target: You're so ugly, I thought I was talking to a burrower for a moment.<end>

segment.source:
Interestin'ly, I always thought burrowers looked pretty damn brutal.
Enough of this, whaddya want, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane)?<end>

segment.source:
That's not a ba--
Wait? Ya serious?<end>
segment.target:

segment.source: Why did you open a bar here?<end>
segment.target: Why did you open a bar here?<end>

segment.source: It's a long story. Wanna hear it?<end>
segment.target: It's a long story. Wanna hear it?<end>

segment.source: Sure.<end>
segment.target: Sure.<end>

segment.source: To get away from yer ugliness. Now, whaddya want, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane)?<end>
segment.target: To get away from yer ugliness. Now, whaddya want, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane)?<end>

segment.source: Nope.<end>
segment.target: Nope.<end>

segment.source: Then, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane), is there anythin' I can get ya?<end>

segment.source: Are you this nice to all your patrons?<end>
segment.target: Are you this nice to all your patrons?<end>

segment.source: I try to treat y'all equally and respectfully... sometimes. But damn it, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane), ya got the nastiest mug of all the folks that walked through this place, and I've seen some who looked like they cleaned their face with rusty barbed wire.<end>

segment.source: Listen, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane), I don't talk about my patrons. How'd ya like if someone came here and asked about yer ugly face? Something like, "Hey, who's the $(#guy/girl) with the ugly mug?"<end>
segment.target: Listen, $(#Ugly Joe/Ugly Jane), I don't talk about my patrons. How'd ya like if someone came here and asked about yer ugly face? Something like, "Hey, who's the $(#guy/girl) with the ugly mug?"<end>
